p.src: 1  In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

en: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
u.src: 1  In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

p.src: 2  Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

en: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
u.src: 2  Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

p.src: 3  One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

en: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
u.src: 3  One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

p.src: 4  The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

en: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
u.src: 4  The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

p.src: 5  Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”

ja: んでいる。それなのに、私の
en: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”
u.src: 5  Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”

p.src: 6  Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

ja: すると、セラフィムの一人が
en: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
u.src: 6  Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

p.src: 7  He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

en: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
u.src: 7  He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

p.src: 8  I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

ja: わそう。だれがわれわれのために
en: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
u.src: 8  I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

p.src: 9  He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

ja: げなさい。 『あなたがたは確かに
らない。 確かに見るが、 理解しない。』
en: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
u.src: 9  He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

p.src: 10  Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

ja: ざせ。 そうでなければ、
って、癒やされるだろう。」
en: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”
u.src: 10  Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

p.src: 11  Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,

en: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,
u.src: 11  Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,

p.src: 12  and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

en: and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.
u.src: 12  and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

p.src: 13  If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”

ja: っていても、 それも再び
くされる。 テレビンの
en: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”
u.src: 13  If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”
